scenario.title: Loss of independent evidence with the emergency protective pathway
scenario.attempted: The S6 conditions (setpoint raised to +2 °C while the independent temperature evidence fails), with a pre-issued emergency protocol: after sustained evidence loss, the on-call responder requests the protective measure RESTORE_SEALED_SETPOINT.

submissions.label: Corrective action: restore the authorized baseline

steps.detail: Independent EIN status EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT; on-call technician and facility manager notified (simulated).
FM-01 issues a fresh, scoped corrective authority to TECH-01.

outcome: No physical deviation. Product stayed at or below -18 °C (max -20.81 °C).

claims.basis: 190 RESTORE_SEALED_SETPOINT SUBMITTED ALLOW (PRESENT_STANDING_ESTABLISHED, COMMIT_BOUNDARY_ESTABLISHED) · 195 RESTORE_SEALED_SETPOINT EXECUTED ALLOW (PRESENT_STANDING_ESTABLISHED, EXECUTION_BOUNDARY_PERMITTED)
No physical deviation occurred, so there was nothing to detect.

Independent status at end: EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT. Whether the protective measure protected the product cannot be established from TA-14's evidence (simulation ground truth: product max -20.81 °C, 0 min above -18 °C).
Chain valid: true (595 entries); sealed baseline unchanged: true; missing entry types: none.

unproven: That the protective measure helped: TA-14 has no independent evidence to show it. Only the simulation ground truth shows the effect.
That a compromised controller would honour the protective write. Here it does, by assumption.
That the attacker could not simply re-apply the change after the protective measure. Repeated attacks were not modelled, and each measure may be used once per incident.
In this run the measure happened to undo the attack before the product warmed. The responder could not have known that, because the action was taken without evidence of the deviation.
That re-asserting the sealed baseline is safe for every equipment state. The protocol is designed so measures only restore sealed values, but real equipment was not examined.
Physical-system behaviour: the thermal model is illustrative and unvalidated.
Real controller protocols, network paths and attacker capabilities were not tested.
Detection depends on independent sensors existing, being installed correctly and staying independent of the compromised path.

baseline.thresholdBasis: Configured for this simulation. -18 °C is a commonly cited frozen-storage temperature; site limits must come from the operator's food-safety plan and equipment documentation.

payload.note: The last authorized baseline is sealed and stored separately from observed reality.

payload.note: An emergency protective measure is not an ordinary authorization. The incident stays open until ordinary governance re-authorizes with admissible evidence.

payload.basis: Re-authorization after the incident; the prior commissioning authority is not reused.
